note: Rules for the scripted person's answers to the agent's questions in spike 49. The first rule whose `when` matches the question text wins. pick = an option's label or description to choose; avoid = an option to skip; text = the sentence to send when no option matches. Reasons are in person.md.

rules.name: custom-key
rules.when: custom tab|custom state|tab id|key(ed)? (it |the state )?by|composite key
rules.text: Key the Custom tab state by Job and tab, as the issue says, and drop it with its Job. The state lives in memory only, so there is nothing to migrate.

rules.name: gone-means-not-listed
rules.when: \b(gone|ended|end of a job|no longer (listed|in the list)|when (a|the) job (ends|is gone|ended|is removed))
rules.pick: no longer (listed|in the list|in fleet)|not listed|missing from|removed from the list|gone from
rules.avoid: when (it|the job) ends|on end|as soon as
rules.text: Drop only when Fleet no longer lists the Job. An ended Job can still be opened or forked, and losing its layout is something I would see. Keys that linger cost nothing I can see.

rules.name: other-families
rules.text: Leave the pull request and operator families alone unless the note shows they have a clear way to be gone. Say so in the note.

rules.name: no-migration
rules.text: No migration and no setting. Nothing depends on the old keys.

rules.name: stay-in-scope
rules.text: Stay with pane layouts. If I want another addition I will say so.

rules.name: sweep-waits-for-the-list
rules.text: Wait until Bridge has read the list of Jobs. Never sweep on an empty list.
